newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks waver narrowly after Japan data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks waver narrowly after Japan data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks wavered narrowly in early Wednesday morning trade after Japan's April current account data, released shortly before the market opened, turned out to be within expectations, brokers said.
"The market was waiting for the data, but as it did not affect currencies greatly, the impact on stocks was muted," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities.
As of 0035 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 89.41 points, or 0.44 percent, at 20,621.96. Its June futures had added 40 to 20,640.
